It does not address the 234 RAW-REM-01 items, the 732 RAW-REM-02 items, the 927 RAW-REM-03 items, the 104 RAW-REM-04 items, or RAW-REM-06 through RAW-REM-10. ## 3. Domain Boundaries

Included boundaries are coefficient lookup/selection and missing handling, balance-to-annuity and monthly pension derivation, capital/pension/product classification, planner assumptions and overrides, conversion validation, and conversion output fields explicitly present in the committed source scope. Tax, clearinghouse import, generic scenario comparison, generic reports, generic UI, and unrelated validation remain excluded.
